title: QUIC RFC 9368 Compatible-Version Runtime Selection Verification
verification_method: Focused RFC 9368 requirement-home tests, a live loopback client/server negotiation proof, targeted v2 interop sanity checks, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers the RFC 9368 runtime-selection slice only. It proves compatible-version selection, negotiated-version adoption, original-versus-negotiated Initial protection retention, and the loopback connection path needed to keep the client and server version state aligned. It does not verify Retry or 0-RTT follow-ons.
preconditions: The repository remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The RFC 9368 requirement-home tests exist under tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/RequirementHomes/RFC9368.
The runtime-selection helpers preserve the original-version Initial protection on the server while rekeying the client to the negotiated version.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9368 requirement-home tests pass, the loopback negotiation proof shows the server selecting the negotiated version and retaining the original-version protection for version-authentication checks, the targeted v2 interop sanity checks stay green, core SpecTrace validation accepts the JSON artifacts, the generated QUIC requirement coverage reports the RFC 9368 runtime-selection slice as traceable, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Passed. Focused RFC 9368 requirement-home tests, targeted v2 interop sanity checks, core SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage refresh, and diff hygiene all passed.
